title: Dexcom Dawn Phenomenon Trend
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), WHOOP recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body and blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, WHOOP, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dexcom:egv
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| where hour>=4 AND hour<=8
| bin _time span=1d
| stats earliest(glucose_mgdl) as start_glucose, latest(glucose_mgdl) as end_glucose by user _time
| eval dawn_rise=end_glucose-start_glucose
| where dawn_rise>30
| sort - dawn_rise
description: Measures the early-morning rise in CGM values so you can spot a repeatable dawn phenomenon pattern instead of treating every morning as random noise.
value: Morning glucose drift changes meal planning, insulin timing, and workout decisions; a steady trend is easier to act on than scattered point readings.
implementation: Ingest Dexcom glucose values at their native cadence; schedule daily and review mornings with a strong pre-breakfast rise.
visualization: Daily bar chart of dawn-rise glucose change.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your blood sugar keeps climbing in the early morning even before breakfast.
